title: World Without End
author: Ken Follett
summary: Set in fourteenth-century Kingsbridge, it follows four children who witness a murder in the forest and grow up through feuds, ambition and the arrival of the Black Death. It is a sequel to The Pillars of the Earth set two centuries later.
readIf: you like long, immersive historical sagas with plenty of intrigue and rivalry.
skipIf: you want subtle characters, or dislike grim scenes of plague and cruelty.
